rule: Generation recipes never become geometry authority. Exact tuning values are experiment seeds, not universal constants.

source_contract.guide_input: a derived structure guide may suppress text/dimensions/hatches, but the full source is retained separately
source_contract.final_overlay: source vector/linework is reapplied after generative passes where appropriate

latent_space.warning: A 0.32 second-pass denoise is not treated as a valid universal latent-upscale setting. Latent upscaling can require substantially more denoise and may move composition.

finishing.vector_overlay: source-controlled; opacity/blend are presentation parameters, not fixed truth
finishing.film_grain: optional presentation texture; disable for technical or measurement outputs

rejection_rules: negative prompt is not a geometry guarantee
ControlNet is not a CAD accuracy guarantee
do not discard the original full drawing after creating a structure guide
do not promote AI or raster-derived geometry to authoritative geometry
do not use style score alone as completion evidence
do not treat vendor/community parameter values as universal without fixture benchmarking
